about: Human verdicts on HWP/HWPX -> PDF conversions (scripts/forms/hwp). A form is templated only when verdict is 'faithful', and only on the listed pages. Evidence 'preview': page matches the HWP's own embedded preview image (ground truth, page 1 only). Evidence 'two_engines': no ground truth exists for the page; the rhwp and LibreOffice+H2Orestart renderings agree on the table grid and label positions and rhwp shows no clipped or overlapping text.

converter.reproducible: rhwp output is byte-identical across runs on the same input (checked on all 11 files)

yeongju-student-loan-interest.notes: 1 page, all 115 source words present, table grid matches the preview.

mju-academic-activity-scholarship.notes: 1 page like the source (H2Orestart pushed the signature block to a 2nd page).

kongju-national-scholarship-ii.notes: Row heights and the 신청유형 grid match the preview (H2Orestart collapsed them).

pnu-hardship-support.notes: Page 2 is the supporting-documents guide (no fields). U+2024 in '부․모' needs DejaVu in the image; without it rhwp drew a box glyph.

yangpyeong-merit-scholarship.notes: Pages 2-3 are the document list and scoring rules (no fields).

jeonju-youth-jeonse-loan-interest.notes: Page 5 (위임장, filled by the delegate) not templated. U+2027 after '수집' on page 4 is drawn from DejaVu and touches the next syllable; label text is complete.

sontaehee-scholarship.notes: University-student forms only: p1 checklist, p3 서식2호 신청서(대학생), p6 서식4호 자기소개서, p7 서식5호 사용계획서. p2 (초중고) and p4-5 (teacher's 추천서) not templated. Every 서식 starts its own page in rhwp; H2Orestart lets each title slide to the previous page.

jeonju-jobseeker-transport.notes: Page 1 (notice) matches the preview; 6 pages = 6 hard page starts in the source. Only 서식1 신청서 templated; 서식2 위임장 is the delegate's.

keimyung-gs-scholarship.notes: Page 1 (form list) matches the preview. Only [양식 1] 장학금 신청서 templated. Page 3 (consent) rejected: the two engines place the signature block about 10% of the page apart and there is no ground truth. Pages 14-17 are the professor's recommendation and research forms.

iksan-love-scholarship.reason: Text missing in both engines. rhwp drops the consent sentence ('위와 같이 본인의 개인정보를 수집·이용하는 것에 동의합니다') and the '▸장 소' line of the ceremony box; H2Orestart drops the 선발유형 checkbox rows and the 동의함/동의하지 않음 boxes.

mpva-veterans-scholarship.reason: The application pages (붙임3/4) have no ground truth and the engines disagree: rhwp draws '. . .(남,여)' over a cell border and spaces rows about 20% taller than H2Orestart. Page 1 also loses the '❶' bullet glyph.

wonju-ai-interview-experience.notes: p1 matches the embedded preview; p2 consent page complete in rhwp (date and signature lines present), H2Orestart shows the same box on its p3 after a blank overflow page.

wonju-study-cafe.notes: p1 matches the preview; p3 consent and p4 미진학 확인서 agree between engines; p2 is 작성요령 only.
